verdict.rationale: A probe confirms RudderStack serves an llms.txt at rudderstack.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it. The official MCP server also lets an agent ask about RudderStack features and get AI-generated answers with source citations. However, the llms.txt contents are only glimpsed, and the markdown docs endpoint (/docs/.md) returns 404, so agent-oriented docs coverage is incomplete. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth and structure (e.g., links to the full docs set or an llms-full.txt), working markdown versions of docs pages, first-party documentation of the llms.txt, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Ask questions about RudderStack features and get AI-generated answers with source citations
